title: fix(site): plainer Quest copy on Community and Home
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The Community Quest leaderboard now describes participants and completed Quests rather than leading with Pollen earned. Its totals show Participants and Quests completed; the total-Pollen card and unused type field were removed, while each contributor’s Pollen remains in their row. Home now says how many people have completed Quests instead of attributing a Pollen total to GitHub Quests.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel-art garden, Polli checks a little leaderboard showing participants and completed Quests, with flowers growing beside it and a prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and a tiny clipboard; she is small within the scene, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream surroundings and dark purple (#110518) pixel lettering.
